rows.red: Empty, foreign-base, badly named or nested modules must fail.
rows.control: Every nonempty selected module contributes exact test IDs.

rows.red: Exit zero without a completion record, missing IDs or no CLI call.
rows.control: Matching actual child exit, IDs, count and CLI evidence.

rows.red: Bundle read-back or manifest failure cannot leave a passing bundle.
rows.control: Final summary and manifest hashes agree after failure.

rows.red: Symlink, hardlink, traversal and FIFO reads/writes.
rows.control: Real random safe file bytes read through the same descriptors.

rows.red: A plain socket under umask 022 fails the production comparison.
rows.control: Exact owner, RPC group and mode are required.

rows.red: An actual timed-out process cannot pass or hang the controller.
rows.control: Real exit and timeout evidence remain readable.

rows.red: Service test identity, unsafe UID inputs or shared primary groups.
rows.control: Actual private accounts, no sudo, and no probe RPC membership.

rows.red: Unprofiled namespace controls before and after profile install.
rows.control: Profiled bwrap works with both host switches unchanged.
Actual pidfd termination, continued safe cleanup and retained failure.

rows.red: Ordinary helper invocation sees a planted shadow module.
rows.control: The same helper under isolated Python sees only trusted imports.

rows.red: Wrong answers/routes, early PONG, hidden ends, wrong actor, missing bytes or sequential trees.
rows.control: The same shared assertions consume matching independent observations.

rows.red: Missing/duplicate rows, changed/linked evidence, setup crash or survivors.
rows.control: Exact result identity, reached rows, actual exit and file hashes.
